# DiasUAE (Dias Accounting and Tax Consulting LLC)

> DiasUAE (legally registered as Dias Accounting and Tax Consulting LLC) is an FTA-Registered Tax Agency and Chartered Accounting firm in the United Arab Emirates, led by FTA-Registered Tax Agent Glen Dias. Headquartered in Sharjah Media City (SHAMS, Trade Licence 2646813.01) and serving Dubai Mainland, DIFC, DTEC, DMCC, IFZA, and all UAE Free Zones, DiasUAE delivers fixed-fee monthly IFRS bookkeeping, 5% UAE VAT compliance, 9% Corporate Tax advisory, 0% Small Business Relief & QFZP structuring, financial forecasting, and statutory dividend audits starting from AED 400/month.
